create_Vocab_pretrained: create a Vocab object with pretrained GloVe embeddings by passing type pretrained and an embedding_name
build_BaseVocab_random: build a BaseVocab with random embeddings from a custom vocab file and specified embedding dimension
create_CustomVocab_embeddings: create a CustomVocab that loads word vectors from a custom embedding file alongside a vocab file
create_IntersectedVocab_pretrained: create an IntersectedVocab that intersects a custom vocab with pretrained GloVe or FastText embeddings
create_ModelVocab_fasttext: create a ModelVocab that wraps a fasttext model to return word embeddings directly via stoi lookup
